supersedesPlanningOnly: v1 workbook Build Backlog remains historical input; this is the active register.
authority: User master prompt v1; open human owners/dates intentionally unassigned

items.title: Complete assignment-to-retest chain
items.rootCause: Legacy modules had no connected assignment/evaluator chain.
items.recommendedCorrection: Create assignment, produce work, evaluate, find gap, correct, retest and verify with one inspectable export.
items.acceptanceCriteria: Create assignment, produce work, evaluate, find gap, correct, retest and verify with one inspectable export.

items.title: Prevent unrelated retest verification
items.rootCause: Legacy canVerify relied on same-pattern rule counts.
items.recommendedCorrection: Require original action/participant, explicit transfer condition, complete reviewed criteria, separate verifier and no unresolved appeal.
items.acceptanceCriteria: Require original action/participant, explicit transfer condition, complete reviewed criteria, separate verifier and no unresolved appeal.

items.title: Preserve corrupt state
items.rootCause: Legacy read recovery could seed and overwrite unreadable storage.
items.recommendedCorrection: Block writes, retain raw data and expose recovery export; refresh must not reseed corrupt state.
items.acceptanceCriteria: Block writes, retain raw data and expose recovery export; refresh must not reseed corrupt state.

items.title: Freeze source/configuration/rubric context
items.rootCause: Legacy run loaded mutable current catalog content.
items.recommendedCorrection: New runs freeze source/scenario/config/rubric; review amendments and invalidations never mutate completed sessions.
items.acceptanceCriteria: New runs freeze source/scenario/config/rubric; review amendments and invalidations never mutate completed sessions.

items.title: Serialize duplicate/stale commands
items.rootCause: No transactional pilot command aggregate existed.
items.recommendedCorrection: Idempotent keys, expected revisions and leases prevent duplicate effects and stale tab overwrite.
items.acceptanceCriteria: Idempotent keys, expected revisions and leases prevent duplicate effects and stale tab overwrite.

items.title: Reject legacy terminal-record replacement
items.rootCause: Local save deleted/reinserted projections, allowing completed fields to change.
items.recommendedCorrection: Reject removal/alteration of terminal runs transactionally; allow appending new records.
items.acceptanceCriteria: Reject removal/alteration of terminal runs transactionally; allow appending new records.

items.title: Constrain roster/CSV input
items.rootCause: Weak header/size/formula/contact constraints.
items.recommendedCorrection: Reject malformed/large/duplicate/prototype columns; neutralize prefixed formulas; allow fictional contact addresses only.
items.acceptanceCriteria: Reject malformed/large/duplicate/prototype columns; neutralize prefixed formulas; allow fictional contact addresses only.

items.title: Publish exact build metadata
items.rootCause: Baseline exposed version but no build SHA/time.
items.recommendedCorrection: Pages renders exact commit/time; live manifest/hash check matches the deployed source.
items.acceptanceCriteria: Pages renders exact commit/time; live manifest/hash check matches the deployed source.

items.title: Strengthen transfer-link test
items.rootCause: Initial targeted mutation survived a missing transferFrom guard.
items.recommendedCorrection: A wrong same-capability transferFrom must fail independently of different-ID and capability guards.
items.acceptanceCriteria: A wrong same-capability transferFrom must fail independently of different-ID and capability guards.

items.title: Keep replay usable as evidence grows
items.rootCause: Replay repeatedly cloned full prior state.
items.recommendedCorrection: Internal isolated replay avoids prior-state copying; measured 25-loop replay/export meets declared synthetic budgets.
items.acceptanceCriteria: Internal isolated replay avoids prior-state copying; measured 25-loop replay/export meets declared synthetic budgets.

items.title: Named practitioner review and calibrated rubric
items.rootCause: Authored synthetic content has no independent approval.
items.recommendedCorrection: Named reviewer validates sources/authority/alternatives/consequences; two reviewers calibrate evidence criteria.
items.acceptanceCriteria: Named reviewer validates sources/authority/alternatives/consequences; two reviewers calibrate evidence criteria.

items.title: Independent accessibility and participant usability
items.rootCause: Automated/agent checks are not human assistive-technology acceptance.
items.recommendedCorrection: Complete keyboard, screen-reader, zoom/timing/recovery and real-device journey; resolve material findings.
items.acceptanceCriteria: Complete keyboard, screen-reader, zoom/timing/recovery and real-device journey; resolve material findings.

items.title: Trusted identity, membership and tenant authorization
items.rootCause: No authorized production project or data agreement.
items.recommendedCorrection: Approve hosting/region/cost/data scope; implement deny-by-default object/file/export access, SSO and tested membership/entitlements.
items.acceptanceCriteria: Approve hosting/region/cost/data scope; implement deny-by-default object/file/export access, SSO and tested membership/entitlements.

items.title: Cloud evidence, backup and retention controls
items.rootCause: Local storage is not an organizational system of record.
items.recommendedCorrection: Private storage, append-only server events, export/hold/deletion policies and measured backup/restore are approved and tested.
items.acceptanceCriteria: Private storage, append-only server events, export/hold/deletion policies and measured backup/restore are approved and tested.

items.title: Live communications, safe scheduling and callbacks
items.rootCause: No approved provider/recipients/consent/sender.
items.recommendedCorrection: Implement transactional outbox, dispatch-time eligibility, consent/STOP, incident hold, signed replay-protected callbacks and provider-failure tests before activation.
items.acceptanceCriteria: Implement transactional outbox, dispatch-time eligibility, consent/STOP, incident hold, signed replay-protected callbacks and provider-failure tests before activation.

items.title: Independent security review
items.rootCause: Source scan and local command tests are limited.
items.recommendedCorrection: Threat-based review of tenant/object/file/export/API and deployment abuse paths; close critical findings.
items.acceptanceCriteria: Threat-based review of tenant/object/file/export/API and deployment abuse paths; close critical findings.

items.title: Complete situation and handover transfer packs
items.rootCause: Only two transfer conditions are authored.
items.recommendedCorrection: Materially different decision/evidence transfer pairs receive source and practitioner review, with linked action/retest tests.
items.acceptanceCriteria: Materially different decision/evidence transfer pairs receive source and practitioner review, with linked action/retest tests.

items.title: Semantic repetition adjudication
items.rootCause: Current detector is a lexical/structural screen.
items.recommendedCorrection: Review flags by field; add a validated semantic comparison only with reproducible thresholds and human decisions.
items.acceptanceCriteria: Review flags by field; add a validated semantic comparison only with reproducible thresholds and human decisions.

items.title: Plan ingestion, change impact and content lifecycle
items.rootCause: Current pilot uses authored frozen excerpts.
items.recommendedCorrection: Approved source extraction preserves provenance, conflicts/review states and prospective reapproval without changing completed runs.
items.acceptanceCriteria: Approved source extraction preserves provenance, conflicts/review states and prospective reapproval without changing completed runs.

items.title: Facilitated multirole/media/integration expansion
items.rootCause: Single-role web slice is the accepted implementation scope.
items.recommendedCorrection: Add only after trusted single-role cycle: approved media rights/accessibility and measured inter-role dependencies.
items.acceptanceCriteria: Add only after trusted single-role cycle: approved media rights/accessibility and measured inter-role dependencies.
